Common questions

Quick answers to what firms ask most before they build.

How much does a law firm website cost?

It depends on how you build it. A DIY site mostly means paying for a domain, hosting or a builder subscription each year. Hiring a developer costs more upfront but saves time and avoids costly mistakes.

See the full cost guide →

Do I need special hosting for a law firm?

Nothing special, just better than the cheapest plan. Look for daily backups, free SSL, malware protection and responsive support, because your site collects client inquiries.

Compare hosting for law firms →

Should I use .com, .law or .attorney?

.com is still the most recognizable and easiest to remember. .law and .attorney work well as extras, but usually cost more to register and renew.

Read .law vs .com vs .attorney →

Is WordPress secure enough for a firm?

Yes, when it is maintained. Keep WordPress, themes and plugins updated, choose good hosting, and turn on strong passwords and two-factor login.
